body: Dan Quinn faces a reported end to his tenure with the Washington Commanders, with multiple outlets citing Stephen A. Smith declaring his time in Washington over. Reports also note Quinn has hired a former head coach amid this uncertain future.

findings.evidence_quote: Stephen A. Smith Says Dan Quinn's Time in Washington Is Over as the Commanders Hit Their Bye
'It's over for Dan Quinn, this is it': Stephen A. Smith does not hold back on Commanders coach
